premises.text: Car technology becomes outdated quickly and more than a billion vehicles already on the road cannot easily upgrade without buying a new car
premises.evidence_span: What about more than one billion vehicles on the road right now?

premises.text: VINLY's small OBD device plugs in like USB and turns post-1996 cars into a connected platform for apps and services
premises.evidence_span: The VINLY platform uses this small device to connect and communicate with your car

premises.text: Built-in consumer apps cover safety, cost savings, and fun driving use cases from day one
premises.evidence_span: We already built a number of apps on the platform so consumers can use Vinly from day one

premises.text: Hardware priced at $49.99 basic or $149.99 complete with Bluetooth, LTE, Wi-Fi hotspot, and advanced crash reporting
premises.evidence_span: available at a phenomenal price of $49.99 for our vinly basic device, at $149.99 for our vinly complete

premises.text: Enterprises can plug devices into fleets for business apps like Fleet Tracker at $149.99 per year including device and data
premises.evidence_span: companies can buy Vinly devices, plug it into their fleet, and start using business applications

premises.text: Open developer platform with APIs/SDKs/backpack hardware lets anyone build connected-car apps across makes and models
premises.evidence_span: developers can build applications for the connected car, regardless of their make and model, because we simplified the complicated car into a simple API call

value.text: Make almost any car on the road smarter than a new assembly-line car via apps and services
value.evidence_span: It can make a car manufactured after 1996, which is almost every car on the road right now, smarter than a car that just left the assembly line

causal_links.evidence_span: the only way to change that is to buy a new car
first true technology platform for the car

notes: App laundry list (Beagle, eCall, Race, Glass, etc.) folded into consumer apps premise (v1.3.2 #5). Developer platform kept separate because speaker frames opening to developers as its own path to value. Prize/Tesla challenge excluded as financing/promo. Traction counts excluded.
